items.headline: Anthropic hands its Agent Skills standard to a neutral foundation
items.summary: Agent Skills, the simple 'instruction folder' format that teaches AI assistants how to do a specific task, is moving to the Agentic AI Foundation under the Linux Foundation. More than 70 tools, including ChatGPT, Cursor and GitHub Copilot, already support it.
items.why_it_matters: A skill you build once for Claude can work in other AI tools too, so your time spent writing reusable workflows isn't locked to one app.

categories.title: Tools & Tips for Creators and Small Biz
